description: FULL RECORD for one object you already have the slug or exact name of (from a search or an alternative): its full sheet and mating features plus the basis of the numbers, every public CAD source with its license, related objects to traverse, FAQ, and paid-pack offers. Use it to cite or verify, check a license, or walk to related parts. Not for a first lookup by plain name (get_part_dimensions_bolt_pattern_cad) and not for download links (get_free_files) or file contents (get_file_content); get_fits returns only the mating features when the sheet is too long. Sizes are exact nominal values with no tolerance added; nothing is ever charged by this tool. An unknown slug is an error with a hint to search first. Read-only, no auth. On this channel paid_offers carry the agent price and the x402 URL (answers 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED; pay in USDC on Base and retry) as well as the card price and page for people.

object.description: Object slug as returned by find_geometry or find_by_dimensions, e.g. '4080-aluminum-extrusion'. An exact object name or alias also resolves; anything else is an error with a hint to search first.
